'''Gwarror''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who hunted [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] as revenge for the Trandoshans' penchant for hunting Wookiees for sport. Gwarror would find Trandoshans who were weak from undergoing the ''[[shko-yagu]]'' ritual and [[Death/Legends|kill]] them, and the Trandoshan [[Veneb Drassk]] gave Gwarror information on his rivals in order to eliminate them. Gwarror attempted to kill the Trandoshan [[Qyzen Fess]] on [[Alderaan]], using the younger Trandoshan [[Lek Svaal]] as bait. However, Fess was a traveling companion of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] known as the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]], and had undergone ''shko-yagu'' with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] medicine rather than the poisonous [[Nakkis leaf/Legends|nakkis leaf]], leaving him strong and healthy. In the following battle, Gwarror [[Death/Legends|perished]].
